type Identity<T> = T;

type Direct<T> = T extends [infer U extends U] ? U : 'no';
type UnionBound<T> = T extends [infer U extends U | string] ? U : 'no';
type IntersectionBound<T> = T extends [infer U extends U & string] ? U : 'no';
type AliasBound<T> = T extends [infer U extends Identity<U>] ? U : 'no';

type RepeatedDirect<T> = T extends [infer U extends U, infer U] ? U : 'no';
type RepeatedUnion<T> = T extends [infer U extends U | string, infer U] ? U : 'no';
type RepeatedIntersection<T> = T extends [infer U extends U & string, infer U] ? U : 'no';
type RepeatedAlias<T> = T extends [
  infer U,
  infer U extends Identity<U>,
] ? U : 'no';

type TwiceExplicit<T> = T extends [
  infer U extends U,
  infer U extends U,
] ? U : 'no';

console.log('done');
